research_question: After RCEP, did firms with stronger pre-policy multi-country RCEP sourcing foundations experience different supplier-link exit, entry, and diversification outcomes?
interpretation_limit: The exposure is a regional cumulation readiness proxy and must not be described as observed use of RCEP cumulative rules of origin.

population.coverage_rule: Firm must map by a documented ticker rule between the FactSet relationship source and the verified firm-year panel and have at least one valid foreign customer or supplier relationship episode observed during 2017-2024.
population.primary_panel: Unbalanced panel; all eligible firm-years retained.
population.balanced_panel: Pre-specified robustness only, never a replacement selected by significance.

policy_timing.note: This is a differential-exposure design, not an estimate of the average RCEP membership effect.

exposure.primary: Number of distinct foreign RCEP supplier countries with an active relationship at at least one year-end during 2017-2019.
exposure.secondary: Indicator that the primary exposure is at least two countries.
exposure.selection_rule: Primary and secondary definitions are both reported and neither is selected by significance.

primary: Incumbent RCEP supplier-link exit rate among links active in t-1
Count of first-time RCEP supplier-link entries
Count of first-time RCEP supplier-country entries
Shannon entropy of active RCEP supplier countries based on link-count shares
HHI of active RCEP supplier countries based on link-count shares, conditional on at least one active link
Net RCEP supplier-link growth: first entries minus exits

zero_and_missing_rules.entry_counts: Zero when no qualifying entry occurs for a covered firm-year.
zero_and_missing_rules.exit_rate: Missing when there is no incumbent RCEP supplier-link risk set in t-1; risk-set counts must be reported.
zero_and_missing_rules.entropy: Zero with zero or one active RCEP supplier country; the active-country count is reported alongside it.
zero_and_missing_rules.hhi: Missing when there is no active RCEP supplier link; conditional sample size is reported.

outcome_family.multiplicity: Report raw and Holm-adjusted p-values across the six primary outcomes.

estimating_equations.static: Y_it = alpha_i + lambda_t + beta(Post_t x Readiness_i) + error_it
estimating_equations.augmented_fixed_effects: firm plus industry-by-year when the industry mapping is validated and has adequate support
estimating_equations.event_study: Y_it = alpha_i + lambda_t + sum_{k != 2021} gamma_k(1[year=k] x Readiness_i) + error_it
estimating_equations.sensitivity_inference: Industry-clustered or wild-cluster inference only if the verified industry count and cluster sizes support it
estimating_equations.count_outcome_sensitivity: Firm and year fixed-effect PPML for entry counts; linear FE remains the common-scale primary specification

identifying_assumption: Absent RCEP, post-2022 changes in the outcomes would not have differed systematically with frozen 2017-2019 regional sourcing breadth after firm and common time effects, and after industry-by-year shocks where supported.
threats: Readiness is selected rather than randomly assigned.
The exposure window overlaps the pre-trend period and can induce mechanical level and regression-to-the-mean patterns.
COVID-era disruption may differentially affect firms with broader Asian sourcing networks.
FactSet relationship coverage and missing end dates may create measurement error.
RCEP implementation coincides with other 2022 regional and domestic shocks.

data_gate: Ticker mapping is one-to-one or all ambiguous mappings are enumerated and excluded by a rule frozen before outcomes are estimated.
Every sample exclusion has a row and firm count in sample_construction.json.
Primary exposure has nonzero mass at zero, one, and two-or-more countries, with no empty post-policy comparison group.
Outcome risk sets and missingness are reported by year and readiness group.
identification_gate: Plot 2017-2024 raw and residualized trends for frozen readiness groups.
Estimate all event-time interactions with 2021 omitted.
Report a joint Wald test for 2017-2020 interactions and outcome-specific pre-coefficients.
Flag the design FAILED for an outcome when the joint pre-trend test rejects at 10 percent or economically large pre-trends remain despite low power.
Run 999 readiness permutations within pre-policy industry-by-size strata using seed 20260723; retain every draw.
evidence_gate: A positive finding requires the frozen post interaction to be unusual under stratified randomization inference and to survive Holm correction within the outcome family.
Direction and magnitude must not be driven by one industry in pre-specified leave-one-industry-out diagnostics.
Passing pre-trends alone is not evidence of an RCEP effect; null post estimates are archived as INCONCLUSIVE, not optimized.

pre_specified_robustness_after_identific: Binary readiness exposure at two or more RCEP supplier countries
Exclude 2020-2021 outcomes while retaining the frozen 2017-2019 exposure
Alternative exposure using 2017 only, clearly labeled sensitivity
Winsorization is not applicable to count and rate outcomes; no outcome-driven trimming will be used
amendment_rule: Any change after freeze must be appended to pap/amendments.md with timestamp and rationale before the changed analysis is run; original definitions remain in this file.
